summary: Corning Incorporated filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution program of up to $2.0 billion of common stock, par value $0.50, sold through or to Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC as sales agent. Shares trade on the NYSE under GLW; last reported sale price on September 8, 2026 was $165.96. Sales agent is compensated 1.00% of gross proceeds; no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for dilution pace and any proceeds earmarked for debt reduction or capacity expansion.
